coverage_and_missingness.note: V4 follows the coverage-aware principle proven by V3. Fields with incomplete observation remain reusable source-native variables only because the generic route preserves blanks as missing rather than converting them to zero.

lost_corners_semantic_resolution.evidence: Opta directly defines Corner Lost as collected for the team conceding the corner and explicitly states that Corner Won/Lost and Corner Taken use different collection criteria, so their aggregate totals may differ.
lost_corners_semantic_resolution.interpretation: The 145 historical mismatches against opponent cornerTaken are therefore not evidence against the lostCorners concept. The 160 historical blanks remain missing.
